discourse.title: Mother and Motherland
discourse.excerpt: The Vedas say, Mathru devo bhava: Revere your Mother as God. This applies to the country which gave birth to you, also.
discourse.theme: Revere your mother as God — and likewise the motherland that gave you birth and culture.

reflection: Swami extends Mathru devo bhava beyond the home: the mother who raised you with love, care and sacrifice, and the land that gave you birth and culture, both deserve reverence. Today, thank your mother — or honour her memory — with one concrete act of care, not just a thought. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 5, 27 Nov 1965)

video.title: Worship Love And You Worship The Divine Mother | Sathya Sai Speaks | October 5, 2003

bhajan.title: Amba Manda Haasa Vadani Manohari Sai Jagat Janani

seva_nudge: Call or visit your mother today with a specific thank-you for one sacrifice she made for you — or, if she is no longer with you, do one kind act in her name.
